verdict.rationale: Lambda's billing docs state that ODC instances are priced hourly but billed in one-minute increments, which meets the per-minute granularity half of the story. The other half, being charged only while the instance runs, is not stated in the docs. A community report shows running instances are billed whether idle or busy, which fits running-time billing rather than contradicting it. missing for 10: first-party statement that billing stops when an instance is terminated or not running, explicit billing behavior for stopped or terminated states, independent corroboration of per-minute billing.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I am billed at per-second or per-minute granularity and only while my instance is actually running

citations.quote: ODC prices instances by hourly usage and bills in one-minute increments.
